_comment: Optional override for the column-name schema used by document comparison.
It is re-read automatically whenever it changes - no restart needed.
GET /api/field-schema/ shows the effective merged schema and any load error.
canonical_fields: extra words a user might TYPE for a concept (appended).
category_schema:  per document category, per concept, the ORDERED list of header
patterns to look for in a table (first match wins). A list given
here REPLACES the built-in list for that category+concept.
New category names are allowed. Known concepts:
part_no, nomenclature, drawing_no, nsn, qty, serial, reference.
